snapshot: Watchlist CivicState: code-present civic-letter product, market and identity still unvalidated.

authority.note: POM soul-review + wrk.dog merge constitute adoption - operator ruling 2026-06-12; see the PR's POM record

methods: tagged all external or future-facing market claims as assumptions

thesis.current: US residents may pay for a bundled civic workflow: issue classification, official targeting, legal-source research, citation verification, letter drafting, payment, delivery, and tracking [evidence: .planning/PROJECT.md; apps/api/src/routes/submissions.ts; apps/worker/src/agents/researcher.ts].
thesis.operatorConstraint: Registry says watchlist personal/research asset; operator must confirm whether to pitch as a business [evidence: registry dispatch].

customer.primary: Individual US resident with a specific civic concern [evidence: .planning/GENESIS.md].
customer.excluded: Legal advice seekers, claim filers, organizations, business advocacy, private-individual targeting, harassment or threats [evidence: MASTER_PLAN.md; .planning/PROJECT.md].

marketSizing.tam: Not asserted; no sourced TAM available in workspace-only mode [assumption: no network research].
marketSizing.method: Bottom-up funnel model using qualified visitors x paid conversion x average order value [assumption: validation model].
marketSizing.validationFloor: 1,000 qualified monthly visitors x 3% paid conversion x $13.50 AOV = $405 monthly revenue [assumption: visitor count and AOV mix; evidence: .planning/PROJECT.md for 3% gate; apps/api/src/routes/payments.ts for prices].

revenueModel.unitEconomics: Single package: $5.00 revenue, $0.20 test cost, $4.80 gross profit, 96% gross margin [evidence: tests/payment.test.ts; assumption: arithmetic].
revenueModel.controls: 40% net margin floor planned, but hardcoded route does not calculate live fee-inclusive margin [evidence: .planning/PROJECT.md; apps/api/src/routes/payments.ts].

goToMarket.initial: SEO-first, driven by opt-in public campaign pages and social sharing [evidence: .planning/GENESIS.md; MASTER_PLAN.md].
goToMarket.risk: No workspace evidence of traffic, indexed campaign pages, paid conversion, or CAC [assumption: validation gap].

holes: Identity mismatch: registry says brooks-history, repo says CivicState [evidence: registry dispatch; package.json].
Demand not validated with paid customers [evidence: .planning/PROJECT.md].
Government email deliverability may fail [evidence: .planning/PROJECT.md; apps/worker/src/agents/delivery.ts].
Citation hallucination or unsafe legal framing could damage trust [evidence: apps/worker/src/agents/researcher.ts].
Official data coverage is not proven nationwide [evidence: apps/api/src/lib/officials/lookup.ts].
mitigations: Operator identity ruling before external pitch.
Paid beta scorecard for conversion, delivery, response, and support load.
Adversarial citation suite and human review for all-failed verification.
Coverage confidence display and provider evaluation for local officials.
residualRisks: Users may not pay even if the product works.
Officials may opt out or treat AI-generated letters as spam.
Compliance requirements may require legal counsel and higher operating cost.

assumptions: SEO can produce qualified demand [assumption: planning hypothesis, not measured].
A 40/40/20 tier mix can support $13.50 AOV [assumption: model only].
One operator can review flagged submissions within 24 hours [evidence: .planning/REQUIREMENTS.md; assumption: workload unproven].

freshness.externalClaims: All external market claims are assumptions because network research is unavailable.
freshness.staleSources: MASTER_PLAN.md is March 2026 and .planning files are dated 2026-04-25 [evidence: MASTER_PLAN.md; .planning/PROJECT.md].

roadmap.nextFocus: identity ruling, paid beta instrumentation, fee-inclusive margin checks, deliverability, citation safety, operator queue proof
